purpose: Prospective source-bound requalification of the current bounded WP08-D contact implementation. This revision does not alter the parent physics contract; it binds the current authorized contact-source correction and requires M1/M2/M3 production, independent references for passing primary cases, and only the parent-contract M1 replay.

governing.execution_sha_binding: Exact clean HEAD is bound by the separate authorization record after this contract and runner are committed.

source_requalification.source_change_summary: For systems above the exhaustive normal-set cap, attempt the normal-only seed exactly once and accept it only if the existing coupled residual and admissibility checks pass; if it is rejected, preserve fail-closed behavior without exhaustive enumeration. For systems within the existing cap, the exhaustive candidate search remains available.

campaign.execution_order: Sequential single-agent, one structural solve at a time: all primary production levels M1/M2/M3; then independent references for each passing primary; then only the M1 replay required by the parent contract if its primary and reference gates pass.
campaign.reference_implementation: Frozen independent NumPy/KKT contact reference; no production contact/friction import or call.
campaign.failure_policy: Preserve every failure as raw evidence. A failed primary blocks its dependent reference/replay only. Do not alter inputs, thresholds, parameters, or fallback behavior after observing results.

qualification_claim: Prospective WP08-D source requalification evidence only; official points remain unchanged and subject to Owner review.
